title: 第23章 引狼入室第24章 互相算计
slug: 重生本统子教宿主当老六
content_zh:
陆沉披上面具走出贵宾室，柳如意恭敬地跟在身后，两人一前一后走出万宝阁的大门。
柳如意恭敬地说道：“前辈慢走，还望常来光顾我们万宝阁。”
不得不说这女人的演技简直无懈可击。
陆沉戴上兜帽，“嗯！”
了一声转身就走。
不远处有两队人看着这一幕，窃窃私语道：“万宝阁老板亲自相送，看来这个老头子就是家长让我们找的人了。
跟上去！”
两队人不约而同地跟了上去，没有离着太近，时刻保持着距离。
陆沉心里说道：“苟系统，我们好像被人跟上了。
怎么办？”
9527一脸悠闲地说道：“别急，要的就是他们跟上来，加快速度，但别让他们跟丢了。”
“啊？”
陆沉搞不明白，但还是听话地加快了速度：“他们是谁？”
“多的那些是吴家人，少的是你们陆家人。”
“吴家人？他们想干嘛？”
陆沉不由得紧张了起来。
苟系统邪魅一笑：“当然是想拉拢你这位炼药大师咯！”
陆沉听完瞬间明白了今天苟系统的操作：“哇！
苟系统你是真的阴啊！”
“苟宿主，你也不算太笨嘛！”

“不过我们陆家人跟着干嘛？”
陆沉又问。
9527摇摇头道：“你还真是不经夸，离你老爸差远了。”
陆沉露出疑惑的神色。
苟系统只好耐心地回道：“你想啊，你现在是一位新来的炼药师，正巧你们陆家落寞了，这时候不应该全力拉拢你吗？吴家人又不是傻子，要是你老爸不派人来，吴家人会怀疑的。”
“我老爸也这么阴险的吗？可是为什么不多派几个人啊？”
“笨啊！
多派几个人打起来怎么办？少派几个可以找理由撤退，还能麻痹吴家，让他们更轻视你们。”
“你们两个老狐狸真狡猾。”
“你要是遗传你老爸一半的脑子，本统子就不至于这么累了。
回去记得给你老爸吃颗定心丸。”
“什么意思？”
“你老爸不知道这老头是你，估计会以为这是你那神秘的老师，毕竟是外人，难免有所怀疑。”
“那我要告诉他这是我假扮的？”
“笨啊，这个老头不就刚好圆了你有个老师的谎话吗？而且我有什么话也可以借着这个老头子的嘴说出来啊！”
content_en:
Lu Chen put on his mask and walked out of the VIP room, followed respectfully by Liu Ruyi, and the two of them walked out of the gate of Wanbao Pavilion one after another.
Liu Ruyi said respectfully: "Senior, please go slowly. I hope you will come and visit our Wanbao Pavilion often."
I have to say that this woman's acting skills are simply impeccable.
Lu Chen put on his hood, "Yeah!"
He turned around and left.
Two groups of people not far away watched this scene and whispered: "The boss of Wanbao Pavilion sent me off in person. It seems that this old man is the person our parents asked us to find.
Follow me! "
The two teams followed them in unison, not getting too close and keeping their distance at all times.
Lu Chen said in his heart: "Gou System, it seems that we are being followed.
What to do? "
9527 said with a leisurely look: "Don't worry, what I want is for them to catch up and speed up, but don't let them get lost."
"Huh?"
Lu Chen couldn't understand, but he obeyed and sped up: "Who are they?"
"Those who have more are the Wu family, and those who have less are your Lu family."
"Wu family? What do they want to do?"
Lu Chen couldn't help but become nervous.
Gou System smiled evilly: "Of course I want to win over you, the alchemy master!"
After listening to this, Lu Chen immediately understood the operation of the Gou system today: "Wow!
Gou System, you are really yin! "
"Host Gou, you are not too stupid!"
"But why are we, the Lu family, following us?"
Lu Chen asked again.
9527 shook his head and said: "You really don't need praise. You are far from your father."
Lu Chen looked confused.
System Gou could only reply patiently: "Think about it, you are a new alchemist now, and your Lu family happens to be lonely. Shouldn't we try our best to win you over at this time? The Wu family is not a fool. If your father doesn't send someone, the Wu family will be suspicious."
"Is my father also so insidious? But why don't you send a few more people?"
"Stupid!
What if we send a few more people to fight? Sending a few fewer people can give you a reason to retreat, and it can also paralyze the Wu family and make them despise you even more. "
"You two old foxes are so cunning."
"If you inherited half of your father's brain, Ben Tongzi wouldn't be so tired.
Remember to give your dad some reassurance when you go back. "
"What do you mean?"
"Your dad doesn't know that this old man is you. He probably thinks he is your mysterious teacher. After all, he is an outsider, so he will inevitably be suspicious."
"Then I'm going to tell him I'm pretending?"
"Stupid, didn't this old man just fulfill the lie that you have a teacher? And if I have anything to say, I can use this old man's mouth to say it!"
